hooks.command: d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/nautilus/.claude"; f=$(ls -1 "$d"/sessions/20*.md 2>/dev/null | tail -1); s=$(ls -1 "$d"/scrum/sprints/S*.md 2>/dev/null | tail -1); [ -n "$f" ] && { echo "[Derniere session : $(basename "$f")]"; tail -n 60 "$f"; }; [ -n "$s" ] && { echo "[Sprint courant : $(basename "$s")]"; head -n 25 "$s"; }; true
